description.narrative: Insatsens huvudsakliga mål: Att öka användningen av evidensbaserade policy process sammanfattningar och rekommendationer för det statliga beslutsfattandet. För att öka generering och överföring av kunskap och teknik som behandlar problemen med nationella prioriteringarna genom att öka medvetenheten om vetenskap, teknik och innovationer. Att etablera ett stabilt informationsystem för styrning och ledning.

Key Objective: To increase the use of evidence-based policy briefs and recommendations for government decision making. To increase the generation and transfer of knowledge and technologies that address problems of the national priorities simultaneous with raising awareness on science, technology and innovations. To establish a robust information management system.

Övergripande fråga: Resultat kopplat till avsedd effekt 2015Fråga: Sammanfatta resultat relaterade till avsedd effekt (denna information kommer att skickas till Open Aid).Svar: COSTECH has achieved some but not all results that was outline in the Annual Plan 2014/15. Its role as coordinator, facilitator for STI nationwide and as an advisor to the government has improved during the year. Among important results the bill for a new STI Act and Policy can be found. The managment capacity has improved and COSTECH is now ISO 9001:2008 certified and has a Performance Managment System is in place. Capacity building has been implemented in Intellectual Propery, record management, audit, foresight, procurement and results based management. COSTECH has adopted RBM as its M&E tool for their new strategy that soon is about to be finalized. Further, COSTECH has made a call for research grants and 22 grants were approved, the majority within agricultural sciences, but also nanotechnology. The innovation programme is improving, mainly with reference to results concerning innovative cluster firms. This year 15 cluster were trained and developed viable business plans out of which 8 were selected for seed funding. Important has been to link clusters to academia in order to develop valued added products. Examples of these are the Magugu rice cluster being linked to Dakawa Research Centre. New farming practices has lead to an avarage of 20% incrase in yield despite poor rainfall. Mwenge Wood carving cluster has been linked to UDSM Entrepreneurship Centre. Zanzibar fruit, vegetable and seaweed cluster is working with Karume Institute of Science and Technology to develop a sun drier for their products. A prototype is being tested. Pemba fish farming cluster was liked to the Institute of Marine Sciences to develop an adequate method for drying fish. Babati sunflower cluster signed a MoU with Selian Agriculture Research Institute to initiate collaboration.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
